title: Jenkinsfile served from the web root
description: The response is a Jenkins pipeline definition: the pipeline block with its agent and stages. It names the credentials bindings, the registry pushes and the deployment targets of the delivery pipeline.
remediation: Exclude pipeline definitions from the deployed tree and deny them at the server level.
limitation: One response body. The rule reads the pipeline structure; it does not run a stage.

observation.body: Keep the pipeline block in a Jenkinsfile at the repository root.
